Drifter packages

Signed package repos for Drifter. Install drifter-desktop for Drifter with the apps a desktop needs, or drifter alone.

Signing key: drifter.asc
ACE0 6510 5193 A93E 5A3E 0493 F8AD 3B38 1388 AF59

Debian 13 (trixie)

sudo install -d /etc/apt/keyrings
sudo curl -fsSLo /etc/apt/keyrings/drifter.asc https://drifterhq.github.io/drifter/drifter.asc
echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/drifter.asc] https://drifterhq.github.io/drifter/deb trixie main" |
    sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/drifter.list
sudo apt update
sudo apt install drifter-desktop

Fedora 44

sudo curl -fsSLo /etc/yum.repos.d/drifter.repo https://drifterhq.github.io/drifter/rpm/drifter.repo
sudo dnf install drifter-desktop

Arch Linux

curl -fsSL https://drifterhq.github.io/drifter/drifter.asc | sudo pacman-key --add -
sudo pacman-key --lsign-key ACE065105193A93E5A3E0493F8AD3B381388AF59
printf '\n[drifter]\nServer = https://drifterhq.github.io/drifter/arch/$arch\n' | sudo tee -a /etc/pacman.conf
sudo pacman -Syu drifter-desktop

Log in

Pick Drifter from your login screen's session menu. For Drifter's own login screen, install drifter-login, then run sudo systemctl enable drifter-login after you turn off your current login manager.
